children: Key TakeawaysBitcoin whales reportedly accumulated approximately 15,000 BTC over the past 72 hours.Large holders also added more than 166,000 ETH and 45 million XRP during the same period.The reported accumulation coincided with a broader cryptocurrency market correction.The activity may indicate increased positioning by large holders, although accumulation alone does not confirm an imminent price recovery.Bitcoin Whales Increase Holdings During Market DeclineLarge cryptocurrency holders have increased their Bitcoin, Ethereum and XRP holdings during the recent market correction, according to crypto analyst Ali Charts.In an October 10 update, the analyst reported that whales accumulated approximately 15,000 BTC over the preceding 72 hours, suggesting increased activity among major holders despite weaker market conditions.Ethereum and XRP Whales Also AccumulateThe reported accumulation extended beyond Bitcoin, with large holders adding more than 166,000 ETH and approximately 45 million XRP over the same three-day period.The figures suggest that accumulation was not limited to a single cryptocurrency, although the report did not specify the wallet thresholds used to classify whale addresses or the underlying transaction methodology.

title: Crypto News | Bitcoin Whales Accumulate 15,000 BTC, 166,000 ETH and 45 Million XRP Amid Crypto Market Correction
